description: Create a bookmark. It starts pending; approve it to publish. Needs a title and a url or source_url. The slug is derived from the title unless given. Curator only.

amount.description: A raise's amount in USD cents.

batch.description: An accelerator batch as the accelerator spells it: "Summer 2026" (YC), "SR007" (a16z speedrun).

cover_url.description: Found from the destination's og:image on approval when left out.

hidden.description: Hidden bookmarks stay approved but leave the public feed.

note.description: Tiago's take: his one-line note on the bookmark.

one_liner.description: A company's name, a spaced em dash, and what it makes, for whom ("Peppermint — Billing and collections for clinical trial sites"); an issue prints it as the item's title, the name in bold, with the round under it. No amount, no investors. Written on approval when left blank.

published_at.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime; defaults to now on create.

source_url.description: The article or announcement, when it differs from url.

tag_groups.description: Tags in their display spelling ("Sands Capital", "$100M+"), grouped.

url.description: Where the bookmark points. ?ref=notacompany is added on the way out and stripped on the way in.

name: create_bookmark
title: Create a bookmark
